name: Track competitor pricing pages daily in Google Sheets using Spider

parameters.content:
## Daily competitor price check
1. Add a Spider API credential (key from https://spider.cloud/api-keys).
2. Edit the list in **Pages to check**.
3. Pick your spreadsheet and sheet in **Append to sheet**. Give the sheet the columns date, competitor, url, status, prices.

'Main Content Only' drops navigation and footers so prices from menus do not leak in. Turn on 'Stealth' on **Scrape pricing page** for a site that blocks plain requests.
